dct_description_sm: The dataset has been developed to study the ocean/ice surface roughness in the marginal ice zone.  The main objective of acquiring the data is to explore the opportunity to get turbulence at the ocean-atmosphere boundary layer using the roughness characteristics of the ice/ocean surface. Another objective is to find methods to differentiate different ice types using laser radiation. Having calculated the turbulence, one will be able to compute the gas and fluxes across the ocean-atmosphere interface. The roughness of the ocean surface due to turbulence can be useful for cyclone studies as well. The sea surface ice roughness studies using laser echo sounding and possible profiling adds another dimension in detection of surface ice roughness and its link to ice formation processes.
dct_title_s: LAser WAve Slope (LAWAS) laser profiling data
